about: gaulatti/clouseau#261: decorated TypeScript sources (fictional Nest classes) and the native counters real producers emit for them. Nothing was executed except under jest (the V8 runs load the fictional modules); hit counts are irrelevant and not recorded. Every producer measures statements for every decorated file, so the opt-in parser path classifies a decorator as a statement site.

istanbul_ts.method: TypeScript transpileModule (CommonJS, ES2021, experimentalDecorators, emitDecoratorMetadata, source map), istanbul-lib-instrument instrumentSync with the input source map, istanbul-lib-source-maps transformCoverage to the original source

v8_loaded.method: jest --coverage --coverageProvider=v8 --coverageReporters=json with the module imported by a spec; tsconfig module commonjs, target ES2023, experimentalDecorators, emitDecoratorMetadata, isolatedModules (the gaulatti/alcantara backend recipe)

v8_unloaded.method: as v8_loaded, with no spec importing the module (collectCoverageFrom only)
